lines.beaver: 첫 번째 지원자 김민준 씨, 어땠어요?
lines.beaver_en: How was the first candidate, Kim Minjun?
lines.beaver_roman: cheot beonjjae jiwonja gimminjun ssi, eottaesseoyo?
lines.en: He gave the impression of being calm and caring.

lines.beaver_en: Really? Didn't he seem a bit slow?
lines.learner: 아니요, 둔한 게 아니라 슬기로워 보였어요.
lines.en: No, he didn't seem slow. He seemed wise.
lines.roman: aniyo, dunhan ge anira seulgirowo boyeosseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: His volunteer story was impressive too.
lines.learner: 네, 선행을 많이 한 순수한 사람 같았어요.
lines.en: Yes, he seemed like a pure person who did many good deeds.
lines.roman: ne, seonhaengeul mani han sunsuhan saram gatasseoyo.

lines.en: Park Seoyeon was cheerful and friendly.
She seemed a bit hasty, but she was capable.

lines.beaver: 성격과 기질에 대해 더 말해 줄래요?
lines.beaver_en: Can you tell me more about her personality?
lines.beaver_roman: seonggyeokgwa gijire daehae deo malhae jullaeyo?
lines.en: She had clear views and seemed generous to others.

lines.beaver_en: I was a bit worried about the third candidate.
lines.learner: 맞아요. 말투가 사납고 폭력적인 성향이 보였어요.
lines.en: Right. His tone was harsh, and he seemed violent.
lines.roman: majayo. maltuga sanapgo pongnyeokjeogin seonghyangi boyeosseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: He reacted too sensitively to the questions.
lines.en: Yes, his answers also seemed careless.

lines.beaver_en: He made a big fuss even over small mistakes.
lines.learner: 네, 좀 침착하지 못하다는 인상을 줬어요.
lines.en: Yes, he gave the impression of not being very composed.
lines.roman: ne, jom chimchakaji motadaneun insangeul jwosseoyo.

lines.beaver: 그럼 첫 번째와 두 번째로 추천할까요?
lines.beaver_en: Then shall we recommend the first and second?
lines.beaver_roman: geureom cheot beonjjaewa du beonjjaero chucheonhalkkayo?
lines.learner: 좋아요. 두 사람 다 좋은 인상을 줬으니까요.
lines.en: Sounds good. They both made a good impression.
lines.roman: joayo. du saram da joeun insangeul jwosseunikkayo.
